shots.narration: 私車公用報銷，出差前先備齊三樣佐證。
shots.subtitle: 私車公用報銷｜出發前先備齊 3 樣關鍵佐證
shots.flow_prompt_en: Photorealistic commercial film, smooth low-angle tracking shot following a sleek metallic silver sedan cruising along a sunlit Taiwan multi-lane highway, green mountains in background, natural daylight, 35mm cinema lens, 4K, 3 seconds, steady fluid motion, no text.

shots.narration: 高速公路通行紀錄，決定你的過路費憑證。
shots.subtitle: 高速公路 eTag 通行紀錄＝過路費報銷依據
shots.flow_prompt_en: Dynamic low-angle upward tracking shot as a silver sedan passes underneath a modern steel overhead ETC electronic toll gantry on a sunny highway, subtle blue sensor glow, crisp asphalt motion blur, 35mm cinema lens, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 第一，確認本人出差登記單已經核准。
shots.subtitle: 佐證 1｜本人已核准之「出差登記單」
shots.flow_prompt_en: Photorealistic corporate film, smooth dolly-in as a silver executive sedan arrives at a modern chemical manufacturing plant entrance gate, glass guardhouse, red-and-white boom barrier arm rising smoothly in bright daylight, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 第二，用 Google 地圖截下當次實際去回程路線。
shots.subtitle: 佐證 2｜Google 地圖去／回程實際路線截圖（個資可遮蔽）
shots.flow_prompt_en: POV close-up inside a modern car interior, a hand holding a smartphone displaying a clean GPS navigation route map from start to destination, finger tapping to capture screenshot, warm natural window light, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 跑幾公里就按個人實際里程與公司單價計算。
shots.subtitle: 里程原則｜依個人實際公里數 × 公司核定單價計算
shots.flow_prompt_en: Macro close-up pushing smoothly toward a glowing smartphone map screen highlighting total driving distance kilometers on a route summary bar, crisp shallow depth of field, corporate explainer style, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 第三，下載含遠通專用章的 eTag 官方扣款明細，不能只截線上畫面。
shots.subtitle: 佐證 3｜遠通官方 PDF 明細（須含「遠通電收電子憑證專用章」）
shots.flow_prompt_en: Macro top-down camera push-in on an official printed highway electronic toll statement paper resting on a desk, focusing sharply on a crisp official circular stamp at the bottom corner, warm office daylight, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.act: 第二篇｜進入系統選單號
shots.narration: 回到座位，打開電腦進入鼎新 BPM 系統。
shots.subtitle: PART 2｜回到座位開啟鼎新 BPM 系統
shots.flow_prompt_en: Medium cinematic shot in a sunlit modern Taiwan corporate office, a young office worker in smart casual attire sits smoothly at a walnut desk and opens a sleek silver laptop, natural window light, 35mm lens, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.act: 第二篇｜進入系統選單號
shots.narration: 點擊左側選單的 EPM，開啟一般費用報銷單。
shots.subtitle: 路徑｜鼎新 BPM ➔ EPM ➔ 一般費用報銷單
shots.flow_prompt_en: Smooth slow dolly-in toward an ultrawide curved monitor on an executive desk, soft ambient blue office lighting, clean enterprise portal UI glowing softly as a cursor glides to click a blue menu card, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.act: 第二篇｜進入系統選單號
shots.narration: 進表單後先核對表頭的公司別、部門跟申請日期。
shots.subtitle: 步驟 1｜確認表頭公司別、申請部門與日期無誤
shots.flow_prompt_en: Over-the-shoulder close-up of a crisp office monitor displaying a modern enterprise expense portal as a mouse cursor clicks the General Expense Claim button, soft depth of field, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.act: 第二篇｜進入系統選單號
shots.narration: 接著在費用明細點選「出差登記單號」旁的查詢鈕。
shots.subtitle: 步驟 2｜點擊「出差登記單號」旁放大鏡查詢鈕
shots.flow_prompt_en: Macro close-up of a hand moving an ergonomic mouse and clicking cleanly, monitor glow reflecting softly on the walnut desk surface, crisp 35mm commercial film, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.act: 第二篇｜進入系統選單號
shots.narration: 從清單選出你這趟實際出差的單號，千萬別選錯張。
shots.subtitle: 步驟 3｜精準勾選「本人當次」出差單號（勿誤選他筆）
shots.flow_prompt_en: Close-up cinematic screen view as a clean translucent modal list appears and highlights a verified business trip row with a soft emerald checkmark glow, steady push-in, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.act: 第二篇｜進入系統選單號
shots.narration: 特別注意右上角的憑證日期，一定要改成實際出差日。
shots.subtitle: 會計重點｜右上角「憑證日期」務必修改為實際出差日！
shots.flow_prompt_en: Sharp macro focus rack on a sleek computer monitor corner showing a date picker field updating smoothly with a warm golden highlight ring, clean corporate aesthetic, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 登打明細的核心鐵律，就是私車里程跟過路費「分開列示」。
shots.subtitle: PART 3 核心鐵律｜A05 私車里程 與 A07 eTag 絕不合併！
shots.flow_prompt_en: High-end 3D corporate motion graphics in a sleek dark boardroom, slow smooth orbital camera around a holographic glass visualization splitting into a glowing cyan left track and an emerald green right track, Apple keynote style, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 第一筆費用類別選 A05 私車公用，稅別碼為免稅。
shots.subtitle: 第一筆明細｜選取「A05 私車公用」（稅別碼：T05 免稅）
shots.flow_prompt_en: Clean close-up on a dark-framed desktop monitor as a sleek dropdown menu opens and selects a blue highlighted category option smoothly, modern office lighting, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 輸入你依實際公里數算出的報銷金額。
shots.subtitle: 金額登打｜輸入依個人實際里程算出的報銷金額
shots.flow_prompt_en: Dramatic macro close-up of fingers typing briskly on the numeric keypad of a sleek modern office keyboard, warm desk lamp glow, blurred monitor light in background, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 右下角費用說明，務必填上你實際駕駛的車牌號碼。
shots.subtitle: 必填欄位｜費用說明欄務必備註「實際車牌號碼」
shots.flow_prompt_en: Close-up tracking pan across a clean digital form notes field as crisp characters appear swiftly, soft amber highlight glow along the border, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: A05 存好後，另外新增第二筆明細報過路費。
shots.subtitle: 新增第二筆｜A05 確認入列後，再新增獨立一筆過路費
shots.flow_prompt_en: Clean macro UI shot of a bright blue plus button being clicked on a crisp enterprise web table, triggering a smooth new row expansion animation, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 第二筆類別選 A07 高速公路通行費。
shots.subtitle: 第二筆明細｜選取「A07 高速公路通行費 (eTag)」
shots.flow_prompt_en: Smooth macro zoom onto a sleek emerald green tag badge pulsing gently on a clean corporate dashboard screen, crisp 4K lighting, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 照遠通官方明細的實際扣款金額填報，絕不跟里程混算。
shots.subtitle: 分列鐵律｜依遠通官方 PDF 實扣金額獨立填報
shots.flow_prompt_en: Close-up of two neatly separated glowing glass cards floating side by side in a dark studio, cyan on left and emerald on right, gently pulsing to emphasize separation, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 如果出差改搭高鐵，費用類別請選 A01。
shots.subtitle: PART 4 其他交通｜搭高鐵選「A01 高鐵車資」
shots.flow_prompt_en: Photorealistic commercial shot, warm morning sunlight streaming through a modern glass-canopy high-speed rail platform as a sleek white-and-orange bullet train glides smoothly into the station, horizontal tracking pan, 35mm lens, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 高鐵發票號碼填票面 13 碼票號，稅別 T02 登打含稅總額。
shots.subtitle: 高鐵重點｜發票號碼填「13 碼票號」｜T02 填含稅總金額
shots.flow_prompt_en: Macro close-up of a crisp high-speed rail ticket held in hand under bright daylight, shallow depth of field focusing sharply on the printed ticket number strip, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 若有產生額外停車費，則選 A06 停車費。
shots.subtitle: 停車費用｜類別選「A06 停車費」
shots.flow_prompt_en: Photorealistic commercial shot of a modern underground smart parking exit lane with linear LED ceiling lights, a sleek automated payment kiosk glowing green as a receipt slides out and the LED barrier arm rises smoothly, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 有發票時看清稅別：T01 填未稅金額，T02 填含稅總額。
shots.subtitle: 稅別鐵律｜T01（外加5%）填未稅額 ｜ T02（內含5%）填含稅總額
shots.flow_prompt_en: Macro shot of a printed official receipt paper on an executive desk, a metallic pen pointing gently at the subtotal and tax lines, crisp warm lighting, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 畫面數字只是範例，一律依手中實際票據金額登打。
shots.subtitle: 實報實銷｜畫面皆為範例，請依手中實際發票與里程登打
shots.flow_prompt_en: Slow smooth pull-back over a neat corporate desk showing multiple neatly aligned travel receipts and a tablet calculator displaying verified totals, clean office daylight, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 所有明細加總，務必等於表頭報銷總金額。
shots.subtitle: PART 5 防呆 1｜確認「明細合計 ＝ 表頭總金額」完全一致
shots.flow_prompt_en: High-end 3D corporate CGI close-up of glowing document cards gliding smoothly into a brushed-steel digital vault with a soft blue confirmation light pulse, dark glass boardroom table, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 接著把出差單、路線截圖、eTag 與發票全部上傳附件。
shots.subtitle: 防呆 2｜完整上傳出差單、去回程路線圖、eTag PDF 與發票
shots.flow_prompt_en: Close-up of a computer screen as three clean PDF and image icons drag and drop smoothly into a glowing digital upload dropzone, progress bars hitting 100 percent green, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 上傳後記得親自點開檢查，確認每份附件都清晰可讀。
shots.subtitle: 防呆 3｜上傳後務必「點開預覽」確認無破圖、印章清晰
shots.flow_prompt_en: Over-the-shoulder close-up of an office worker reviewing a crisp PDF document preview on a bright monitor, nodding subtly in confirmation, soft natural daylight, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 送簽前，先按一次「儲存」，確認沒有紅字提醒。
shots.subtitle: 防呆 4｜送出前「先按儲存」，確認無任何紅字欄位漏填
shots.flow_prompt_en: Macro 3D CGI shot of a sleek metallic blue Save Draft pill badge illuminating brightly with a gentle specular light sweep over a glass table, shallow depth of field, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 確認無誤後，再正式按下「送出」發起簽核。
shots.subtitle: 步驟 5｜無錯誤提示後，正式按下「送出」發起線上簽核
shots.flow_prompt_en: Macro 3D CGI shot of an emerald green Submit pill badge lighting up sequentially next to a blue Save badge, emitting a crisp clean light ripple, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 並到待辦區確認已成功產生正式 BPM 單號。
shots.subtitle: 步驟 6｜至待辦區確認已產生正式 BPM 單號才算送出成功
shots.flow_prompt_en: Close-up of a sleek modern smartphone resting on a sunlit walnut office desk, screen illuminating with a crisp green checkmark Approved notification glow, warm morning light, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 線上送完還沒結束！請把報銷申請單列印出來。
shots.subtitle: PART 6 實體交件｜線上送出後，請列印 BPM 報銷申請單正本
shots.flow_prompt_en: Medium close-up of a sleek modern corporate multifunction laser printer smoothly printing and sliding a crisp white expense report sheet into the output tray, bright clean office lighting, 35mm lens, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 連同實體發票、收據正本、路線圖與 eTag 明細整齊裝訂。
shots.subtitle: 裝訂正本｜報銷單 ＋ 發票／收據正本 ＋ 路線截圖 ＋ eTag 蓋章明細
shots.flow_prompt_en: Macro top-angle close-up on a warm walnut desk, hands pressing a sleek metallic stapler neatly onto a white corporate expense form aligned with official paper receipts bearing red circular stamps, crisp daylight, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 先親手交給人事單位核對正本與線上內容完全無誤。
shots.subtitle: 交件順序 1｜申請人先交由「人事單位」核對正本無誤
shots.flow_prompt_en: Medium cinematic shot in a bright glass-walled corporate office, a Taiwanese employee politely hands a neat stack of stapled expense papers across a desk to a smiling HR specialist who raises a red verification stamp, natural sunlight, 4K, 3 seconds.

shots.narration: 最後由人事轉交會計審核入帳，零退件順利完成報銷！
shots.subtitle: 交件順序 2｜人事轉交「會計審核入帳」➔ 零退件順利完成！
shots.flow_prompt_en: Wide cinematic pull-back inside a sunlit modern glass corporate office showcasing three luminous frosted-glass workflow pillars lighting up in sequence connected by a flowing golden-blue light beam, warm professional film look, 4K, 4 seconds.
